svg.title: Priyanshu Singh, built by agents
svg.desc: A shared canvas, like a multiplayer design tool, with 6 AI agents shown as named cursors building Priyanshu Singh's profile: planner lays out the frames, scribe types every word, curator sorts the board, builder wires the pipeline, reviewer leaves the comments, ops watches the numbers. The name, priyanshu singh, is typed out with the tagline "software engineer & POD lead at Xeno" and "now: tech lead on zero-engineering POS onboarding". Sticky notes get sorted: SE 2 @ Xeno (POD lead, onboarding), 13k+ users (gsoc made easy), 1.7k MAU (vhs purnea school erp), agent-receipt (building: PR receipts). A product flow shows how each product was built, idea, design, build, launch: crackgsoc.com (crack gsoc, org filters, ts + pg, 13k+ users) and vhspurnea.com (school erp, fees, exams, react + php, 1.7k MAU); each launch goes boom, with confetti, and its user count runs up. Over about a minute and a half the crew also holds a standup in a circle, types "still here? hi!" for anyone still reading, and flies a victory lap. An activity feed scrolls as they work. din in bhilai: pairing with priyanshu.
